description: Department of Local Government - Central Province - First meeting to elect the Chairman of Nawalapitiya U/C
reasoning: This gazette content announces the first meeting to elect the Chairman of the Nawalapitiya Urban Council, which falls under electoral processes and related matters. The notification is made under Section 66g of the Local Government Elections Ordinance, specifically addressing the scheduling of an election meeting for a local government position. This directly corresponds to Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) which covers "Election announcements and schedules" and "Electoral commission appointments and decisions."
